# Layouts

Positioning rules that arrange blocks, such as grids and lines.

## What's here

Only `BlockLine.js` has code; `Cloud.js` and `Grid.js` are empty.

## How it connects

- Part of [Blockframes](../README.blockframes.md); `Painter.js` picks the right file by block class name.
